clusters.title: Sunrise Apartments Collapse – Building Collapse
clusters.summary: About 7 trapped (7 confirmed by their own reports), children present (about 4), 3 injured, 37 reports. Hazards include debris, blocked roads, gas leaks, and fires. Immediate needs are rescue operations and medical assistance. Priority should be given to the trapped individuals at Sunrise Apartments and Sector 29.

clusters.title: Market Fire – DLF Phase 3
clusters.summary: About 5 trapped (5 confirmed by their own reports), children present (about 1), 2 injured, 18 reports. A fire has broken out in the market area of DLF Phase 3, spreading to residential floors and causing gas leaks. People are trapped, and there are injuries. Immediate needs include evacuation, medical assistance, and rescue. Priority should be given to evacuating people and providing medical care.

clusters.title: School Collapse – Sector 14 – Building Collapse
clusters.summary: About 2 trapped (0 confirmed by their own reports; one report says up to 8), children present (about 3), 3 injured, 16 reports. Parents are gathered outside, seeking updates and assistance. Immediate rescue and medical help are needed.

clusters.title: Earthquake – Sector 56 – Trapped
clusters.summary: About 1 trapped (1 confirmed by their own reports), no children reported, 1 injured, 1 reports. Immediate rescue and medical assistance are needed. People affected include the injured and those nearby.

clusters.title: NH-48 Flyover Cracks – IFFCO Chowk
clusters.summary: No children reported, 12 reports. Cracks and damage to the NH-48 flyover near IFFCO Chowk have blocked the road, causing traffic disruptions. People are affected, and there are hazards such as debris and a damaged flyover pillar. Evacuation and shelter are the most requested needs. Immediate action should focus on clearing the road and providing temporary shelters.

clusters.title: Market Gate Fire – Downed Power Lines
clusters.summary: No children reported, 6 reports. Reports indicate downed power lines and a burning transformer near the market gate, posing hazards such as sparks and fire. People are affected, and immediate needs include evacuation, power restoration, and medical assistance. First action: Evacuate the area and secure the perimeter to prevent further injury.

clusters.title: Leisure Valley Park – No Food – Water
clusters.summary: Children present (about 10), 28 reports. No injuries have been reported, but the area is lacking in food, water, and shelter. Immediate needs include water, food, and medical assistance. First action should focus on providing essential supplies and setting up temporary shelters.

clusters.title: Earthquake – Civil Hospital
clusters.summary: No children reported, 1 injured, 22 reports. Following an earthquake, the Civil Hospital is experiencing a power outage, with patients and staff relying on torchlight. Injured people are lying outside the hospital, and patients have been moved to the courtyard due to structural damage. Immediate medical help, power restoration, and shelter are urgently needed.

clusters.title: Earthquake – Minor Shaking
clusters.summary: No children reported, 7 reports. An earthquake was reported in the Downtown District, with minor shaking and no injuries or significant damage. People are safe but feeling scared. The main concern is psychological. First action should focus on providing emotional support and reassurance.

clusters.title: Earthquake
clusters.summary: No children reported, 4 reports. An earthquake struck the Downtown District, causing power outages in several blocks. Families are safe but reporting downed power lines pose a risk. Priority should be given to ensuring the safety of residents and addressing the power issues.

clusters.title: Earthquake
clusters.summary: No children reported, 3 reports. An earthquake struck the downtown area, causing power outages in several blocks. People are safe but concerned about the lack of electricity. Downed power lines pose a hazard. First action should be to ensure the safety of residents and address the power lines.

clusters.title: Felt Shaking – Safe
clusters.summary: No children reported, 3 reports. Residents in the area reported feeling strong shaking but are all safe with minor wall cracks. No injuries or trapped individuals have been reported. The situation is currently low severity, and immediate needs are not stated. Monitoring the area for any changes is recommended.
